This doesn't mean we're done making Alex and Steves, far from it! This is canonically the last animation to take place before Alex and Steve Adventures, which we wrapped up last year. We wanted to make an official watch order for everything we've done so far, which goes: Animation Life Full Movie, Alex and Steve Life movies 1 and 2 (this will be the final episode of Full Movie 2), Alex and Steve Adventures full movie, and now we're moving on to Legends, the next chapter in the saga! We hope you enjoy Axolotl Battle and show Omeleto some love in the comments for another banger episode of his!
